scope: Risk-selected hypotheses for independent runtime review across actor/object, item, scene/resource, queue/save and audio/render interfaces. Expectations were specified before runtime traces; no runtime capture has been reviewed for these claims. Static evidence uses instruction listings rather than decompiler-generated C.

claims.proposition: A nonnull state pointer is freed without clearing object+0x54.
claims.expected_observation: For null state no allocator call; for nonnull state one free(state); object+0x54 retains its old bits.

static_evidence.justification: No store targets object; free argument loaded from its state slot.

limitations: Allocator ownership and absence of aliases require lifetime captures.
Static observations do not establish execution coverage or independently validate recovered semantic names.

claims.proposition: Children are destroyed before their parent and next siblings are saved before destroying the current object.
claims.expected_observation: On a two-child hierarchy, callbacks observe child destruction before parent and every sibling once; null root produces none.

static_evidence.justification: Recursive child call precedes local destruction; next sibling captured first.

limitations: Assumes acyclic links and callbacks do not invalidate saved siblings.
Static observations do not establish execution coverage or independently validate recovered semantic names.

claims.proposition: Mode six masks flags with 0x1FFFFEFF, adds 0x008000C0, and stores mode as a byte at state+7.
claims.expected_observation: Seed independent flags, set mode six, compare the exact mask/or and byte write; capture hierarchy flag calls separately.

static_evidence.justification: Direct mask and width agree with the proposed mode field.

limitations: Meaning of every affected bit and gameplay reachability remain unverified.
Static observations do not establish execution coverage or independently validate recovered semantic names.

claims.proposition: Ownership byte values four and five reject pickup regardless of holder selector.
claims.expected_observation: With ownership four/five and varied flags/byPlayer, return zero and do not write item state.
limitations: Names of ownership states and other pickup rules need additional scenarios.

claims.proposition: Region creation stores the supplied waypoint pointer in a separate 16-byte state rather than copying waypoint data.
claims.expected_observation: Observe allocation size 16 and state+12 equal input points; alter one live waypoint under controlled capture and verify reader uses it.

static_evidence.justification: Pointer identity is retained, so storage must outlive its consumers.

limitations: Whole scene-unload ordering and negative-X termination are outside this function.
Static observations do not establish execution coverage or independently validate recovered semantic names.

claims.proposition: An uncached compressed asset reserves decoded storage and queues ROM data into a distinct staging buffer; this function performs no decompression.
claims.expected_observation: Record two allocations and queued destination; cache pointer differs from staging; cached second request queues no read.

static_evidence.justification: Decoded cache reservation is separate from the retained staging pointer and DMA destination.

limitations: Synchronization, staging release, and repeated uncached request safety need caller-level traces.
Static observations do not establish execution coverage or independently validate recovered semantic names.

claims.proposition: Polling consumes currently available completions nonblocking and returns remaining pending count.
claims.expected_observation: Supply zero/one/several completion messages with valid pending count; calls use mode zero and pending decreases once per successful receive.

static_evidence.justification: Receive success controls decrement loop; returned word is the pending counter.

limitations: Queue ordering, interrupts and malformed pending counts require full-system coverage.
Static observations do not establish execution coverage or independently validate recovered semantic names.

claims.proposition: Field storage clamps signed input against type-specific bounds, uses type-specific write widths, and returns the clamped value.
claims.expected_observation: Exercise below-minimum/in-range/above-maximum values per field type; verify return and exact byte write footprint, including neighboring packed bits.

static_evidence.justification: Signed comparisons select bounds; dispatch explicitly distinguishes word/halfword/byte and packed stores.

limitations: Requires valid field metadata; packed signed-shift behavior and EEPROM persistence are not validated here.
Static observations do not establish execution coverage or independently validate recovered semantic names.

claims.proposition: Shutdown sets a request then waits for an acknowledgement message; request alone does not prove worker resources are unused.
claims.expected_observation: Delay acknowledgement; caller remains blocked after request until worker sends stop message.
limitations: Scheduling, deadlock preconditions and actual resource lifetime require running worker traces.

claims.proposition: Renderer receives commands, count pointer, transformed sample pointer and sample frames; zero count skips task submission and acknowledges shutdown.
claims.expected_observation: Renderer writes zero count; no synthesis submit/AI buffer calls occur; stop acknowledgement precedes thread stop.

static_evidence.justification: Four ABI arguments and the zero-count branch are explicit.

limitations: Pointer transformation is target-specific; callback bounds and audible/RSP correctness remain unverified.
Static observations do not establish execution coverage or independently validate recovered semantic names.

claims.proposition: The draw callback receives the object and its returned display-list pointer replaces the default; null prevents display-list emission.
claims.expected_observation: Eligible object with matrix and callback returning null emits no object matrix/list commands; callback returning a valid list selects that list.

static_evidence.justification: Callback return flows directly into draw eligibility and command data.

limitations: Graphics microcode validity, visual output and root drawChild effects need full-system tests.
Static observations do not establish execution coverage or independently validate recovered semantic names.
